review.notes: Full review of the restricted head (main outside §1.4 plus the §1.4 Wronskian amendment). Blocking, all inherited from main: LinearFormsInLogarithms is cited although it is on the never-cite list (P1); DerivedDeRhamCohomology and GeometryOfNumbersAndQuadraticArithmetic are upward suppliers (P2); relativePluckerPoint has sorry in its body (P2). §1.4 findings (P3): the multivariable genWronskian layer, the Thm 3.3.7 criterion, Lem 3.3.9 and the §3.4.5 bound are still restated although Tau Ceti proves them; eight admitted examples; the degree estimate is stated over fields only; a closing sentence defers to an unnamed application.
